Cards.title: Product Engineering
Cards.description: Building and evolving web applications end to end: complex forms, async flows, REST API integration and state management.

Cards.title: Frontend Architecture & Design Systems
Cards.description: Component libraries, shared conventions and refactoring that keep products consistent and maintainable across teams.

Cards.title: Performance & Quality
Cards.description: Core Web Vitals, accessibility, technical SEO and code review as part of everyday work.

Paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer based in Rio de Janeiro, working on web products since 2019. My path goes from a corporate DXP platform at Lumis, through performance- and conversion-focused products at H&W Publishing and freelance projects for clients across different industries, to AI-powered SaaS applications at Begen.

Most of my work sits where software engineering meets the interface: frontend architecture, Design Systems and the product logic behind each screen. I work daily with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Svelte and SvelteKit, collaborating closely with Product Design, Backend and QA.

I'm comfortable stepping into existing codebases: understanding what is already there, refactoring with care and evolving the product without breaking what works. In independent projects I explore architecture decisions end to end, such as an offline-first finance app with documented ADRs.

Experiences.Summary: Responsible for developing and evolving SaaS applications using SvelteKit, Svelte 5 and TypeScript.
Highlights: Contributed to the creation and evolution of a reusable Design System, focusing on component architecture, consistency and scalability.
Developed complex application interfaces and reusable components, prioritizing maintainability and performance.
Integrated frontend applications with REST APIs, implementing asynchronous workflows, data synchronization and state management.
Applied modern frontend architecture practices to improve code organization and application consistency.
Participated in code reviews and collaborated with backend engineers, designers and QA to deliver product improvements.

Experiences.Summary: Building and maintaining web applications in Next.js, React and TypeScript, focused on performance, technical SEO and conversion.
Highlights: Built and maintained applications in Next.js, React and TypeScript, focused on componentization and code reuse.
Optimized performance and Core Web Vitals, keeping Lighthouse scores above 80 in performance, accessibility and SEO.
Implemented on-page technical SEO and accessibility best practices to broaden organic reach and keep experiences inclusive.
Built responsive, high-converting interfaces, translating business requirements into fast products that stay consistent across devices.
Applied A/B testing and CRO to inform data-driven UX decisions.

Experiences.Summary: Responsible for the full lifecycle of web projects for clients across different industries, from requirements and architecture to deployment and maintenance.
Highlights: Owned the complete project cycle (requirements, architecture, development, deployment and maintenance) using React, Next.js and TypeScript.
Delivered 20+ projects across different industries (education, crypto and institutional), adapting architecture and stack to each business context.
Built a platform with a members area and a content management dashboard, integrating the frontend with REST APIs and authentication flows.
Focused on performance, responsiveness and SEO to maximize conversion and reach for delivered products.

Experiences.Summary: Built responsive, accessible interfaces for a corporate DXP platform, progressing from intern to full-time.
Highlights: Built responsive and accessible interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, Sass and JavaScript on a corporate DXP platform.
Created and maintained a library of reusable components, speeding up new requests and standardizing visual identity.
Implemented on-page SEO and WCAG accessibility compliance, improving indexing and organic reach.
Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams translating UX/UI designs into user-centered products, including HubSpot CRM integration for lead capture.

Feedback.Title: Testimonials
Feedback.SubTitle: What people say about working with me
Feedback.TextIntro: Feedback from clients and colleagues I've worked with over the years.

Feedbacks.Name: Anderson Nascimento
Feedbacks.Text: Dear Bruno, thank you so much for developing my company's website. It is undoubtedly another dream come true for all of us. The website has been a success and extremely valuable.

Feedbacks.Name: Rodrigo Marques
Feedbacks.Text: Bruno is a great professional and managed to make my dream and goal come true for years! We talked, and he quickly understood the demand and what I needed. He got it right the first time and delivered the website without having to make any changes. It was exactly what I needed and wanted! Thank you Bruno for making my dream come true! We are in this together!

Feedbacks.Name: Thayane Fabiano
Feedbacks.Text: Working with Bruno at Lumis helped me a lot to understand more about development and become a better designer. His willingness to learn, collaborate, and dedication to delivering the best possible result left an excellent impression on me.

Feedbacks.Name: Luis Fernando
Feedbacks.Text: It is the fulfillment of a long-time wish; Bruno helped us understand the process between imagining and making it happen, and from there, it's all history. I'm very happy with the result!

Feedbacks.Name: Bruna Gomes
Feedbacks.Text: Bruno is a very dedicated and helpful professional. We worked together on several projects, where he demonstrated a lot of efficiency and agility, always delivering great work.

Feedbacks.Name: Daniel Clemente
Feedbacks.Text: I had the pleasure of working with Bruno when he was part of the Marketing team at Lumis. Bruno was always very helpful and showed mastery over what he did and said. With him, I was able to better understand development and how our area worked together.
